description: Test suite for token recognition functions related to silent reply tokens, including detection, stripping, and prefix matching.

methods.name: isSilentReplyText
methods.description: Checks if the input text matches the silent reply token, considering optional custom token.

methods.name: stripSilentToken
methods.description: Removes trailing silent reply token from the input text, if present.

methods.name: isSilentReplyPrefixText
methods.description: Determines if the given text is a prefix of a silent reply token, with specific guarding against ambiguous prefixes.
